_comment: AQE setup and pipeline problems, reproduced by aqe-repro.mjs on scratch folders (2026-10-29). Each run lists AQE 0.2.0 results; 0.1.5 gave the same except where 0.1.5 is set.

runs.problem: setup --check exits 1 ("fail") when something is missing
setup --no-install reports "ready" (exit 0) while Playwright is not installed
an existing config file that is not valid JSON is reported "present (kept as is)", and the setup stage is done
runs.command: aqe setup --no-install; break config/dsm-config.json; aqe setup --check --json; aqe pipeline status --json

runs.problem: a second pipeline start drops the app name recorded by the first
runs.command: aqe pipeline start --url https://app.example.test --repo <project> --app Shop; aqe pipeline start --url https://app.example.test --repo <project> --channels web

runs.problem: a state.json that is not valid JSON (here cut off mid-write) is replaced by a new file without a word: inputs and marks are lost
runs.command: truncate .autonomous-qe/state.json; aqe pipeline mark reports skipped

runs.problem: pipeline reset accepts an unknown stage (a typo) and does nothing
pipeline mark dsm done exits 0 but the stage stays pending: evidence wins, and nothing says so
runs.command: aqe pipeline mark dsm done (no dsm/dsm.json)

runs.problem: pipeline start records a repository path that does not exist
the configured repository is gone, but the DSM stage is done with no warning (errors are swallowed)
setup replaces a workspaces object ({packages, nohoist}) with an empty array
